overview.en:
Research DeFi data and access 1inch swaps, limit orders and portfolio tools with account authorization.

Explore protocol markets and positions before preparing a transaction. Specify the network and asset, compare the available data, and keep any proposed transaction separate from execution.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
研究 DeFi 数据，并在账号授权后使用 1inch 兑换、限价单与投资组合工具。

先研究协议市场与仓位，再准备交易。指定网络和资产后比较可用数据，并把交易方案与实际执行分开。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Review the available markets for this asset on Ethereum and summarize the differences.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查看该资产在以太坊上的可用市场，整理差异。

starterPrompts.en: Analyze this wallet's protocol positions and identify the main exposures.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 分析这个钱包的协议仓位，列出主要风险敞口。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a transaction plan for this asset and explain the inputs before execution.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为该资产准备交易方案，在执行前说明所需参数。

descriptions.en: Use 1inch in Ghast. Research DeFi data and access 1inch swaps, limit orders and portfolio tools with account authorization. 研究 DeFi 数据，并在账号授权后使用 1inch 兑换、限价单与投资组合工具。
